prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production animation sprite atlas on genuine transparent background.
Input image: edit target and strict identity/geometry reference: Remy greeting pose.
Create a precise 3-COLUMN by 2-ROW animation sprite sheet, landscape 1536 x 1024, six equal 512 x 512 cells, NO grid lines or labels. Each cell contains the SAME full-body Remy, exactly matching the supplied artwork, camera, lighting, paper edges, plum folder texture, golden face, shoes, materials and proportions. Keep the body, paper stack, feet and silhouette absolutely fixed in exactly the same pixel coordinates within all six cells. Character roughly 460 px tall in each 512 cell, anchored to same foot baseline, generous transparent gutter. No ground shadow. No scene.
Frames in row-major order:
0: original cheerful greeting, open eyes, raised right-side waving hand.
1: identical with eyelids halfway closed, natural half blink.
2: identical with both eyes closed in soft happy curved eyelids, blink.
3: identical with eyes glancing slightly down toward image-left, a subtle attentive expression; body and raised hand unchanged.
4: identical with eyes looking toward image-right and a little upward, friendly look-away; body and raised hand unchanged.
5: original eyes open, ONLY the raised hand gently pivots 12 degrees inward at the wrist, tiny friendly wave articulation; rest unchanged.
Extremely subtle acting, NOT six different poses, NOT a redesign. Facial edits and one tiny wrist edit only. These frames will alternate at 70ms during blinks, so absolute alignment and consistency are essential. Transparent alpha everywhere outside the character. No text, no numbered frames, no background tiles, no extra elements.

Keep folder, papers, feet, arms apart from that one wrist, and face plate fixed. This is six tiny acting changes to ONE pose, not six different whole-body poses.

Create SIX chronological intermediate animation frames of Remy gently covering BOTH eyes using the large plum hand on image-right, for password-entry privacy. Start from the exact supplied default pose. Frame0 original neutral smiling pose, eyes visible, hand at side. Frame1 right-side forearm lifting, hand just below yellow face plate. Frame2 hand halfway upward across lower face, both eyes still mostly visible. Frame3 hand reaches eyes, covering one eye and part of the second. Frame4 hand fully covers BOTH eyes horizontally, fingers relaxed. Frame5 same fully covered-eyes pose, hand settles a few pixels. Cover the EYES, not the mouth; the smile may remain visible below the hand. No peeking, no gaps showing an eye. Keep left hand, folder, papers, body, feet, perspective and face position absolutely fixed across all six cells, only articulate the lifting arm naturally. Each sprite is same size as supplied reference, anchored identically. This will play forward over 350ms on focus, hold frame5 while typing, and play backward on blur. Warm friendly acting, not dramatic.
